summary: Regression test after AuthContext useMemo/useCallback refactor and page-level load() useCallback refactors. All targeted flows pass end-to-end with no infinite re-render, no auth loop, and no functional regression. Backend unchanged and confirmed working via UI-driven integration (auth, tasks CRUD/toggle/filter, goals + AI breakdown produced 5+ tasks, notes CRUD + auto-select + switching, chat streaming + clear, profile persistence after reload, logout).
passed: Login with demo@momentum.app -> lands on /app/dashboard (AuthContext refresh + useMemo value stable, no reload loop observed)
TasksPage: create task, task appears in list, task-toggle-<id> flips status, task-filter-done/all works
GoalsPage: create goal, goal-breakdown-<id> returns and Tasks page shows 9 tasks after breakdown (5+ generated)

NotesPage: new-note-button creates note, save-note-button persists title/content, sidebar shows note-item-<id>, auto-selection works on mount when notes exist (title 'Regress Note' auto-populated in editor), switching between notes updates editor draft
ChatPage (/app/coach): chat-input + chat-send-button streams assistant response (28+ chars observed), clear-history-button empties chat-messages, no closure-stale bug on load()
ProfilePage: working-style / mindset / preferences fields save via profile-save-button and persist after full page reload (verified by re-reading value after page.reload())
Logout via logout-button clears session and redirects to /login
No React 'maximum update depth' or infinite refresh warnings observed in console during any flow

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — accessibility nit, not a functional bug.

critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext value is memoized correctly with all callback deps; useEffect(refresh) is safe because refresh is stable via useCallback([]). No infinite loop risk.
NotesPage.load() uses functional setSelected(prev => ...) which correctly avoids closure over stale 'selected'. Verified auto-select first-note behavior still fires on mount.

Note: The route for chat is /app/coach (not /app/chat as loosely referenced in the review request). Not a bug — just a routing naming inconsistency between the review-request wording and the actual routes.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 goal (breakdown produced ~8 tasks), 1 note, and a profile update on demo@momentum.app during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chat route is /app/coach (not /app/chat). Notes auto-select requires notes to exist server-side; first-mount with 0 notes correctly shows empty pane.
